Plot Trajectory Discrimination Results

Source: R/trajectory.R
plot_trajectory_discrimination.Rd

Visualizes trajectory variability timecourses or separation profiles produced by trajectory_timecourse or trajectory_separation.

Usage

plot_trajectory_discrimination(x, ...)

# Default S3 method
plot_trajectory_discrimination(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'lys'
plot_trajectory_discrimination(
  x,
  data_type = c("timecourse", "separation"),
  score_col = NULL,
  palette = "Set1",
  alpha_ribbon = 0.25,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A lys object or result list.

...

Additional arguments passed to specific methods.

data_type

Character. Which result to plot: "timecourse" or "separation". Default "timecourse".

score_col

Optional character specifying which separation metric to plot ("d_prime", "centroid_dist", "bhattacharyya", "silhouette").

palette

Character. RColorBrewer palette name. Default "Set1".

alpha_ribbon

Numeric. Transparency of confidence interval ribbons. Default 0.25.

Value

A patchwork/ggplot object, returned invisibly.
